extracted.name: Peanut Butter French Toast
extracted.description: If you love French toast and you love peanut butter, why not combine them into one easy, delish recipe? Top with sliced strawberries or bananas.
instruction_lines: Whisk milk, eggs, peanut butter, sugar, vanilla extract, and cinnamon together in a large bowl.
Heat oil in a griddle or frying pan over medium heat.
Dip bread slices in egg mixture, soaking both sides; add to griddle. Cook until golden, about 3 to 4 minutes per side. Serve hot.
